newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Baycorp to buy Registry Managers NZ.
newsitem.headline: Baycorp to buy Registry Managers NZ.

text.p: New Zealand debt collection and credit reporting company Baycorp Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was to acquire 100 percent of Registry Managers (New Zealand) Ltd for about NZ$22 million, including costs associated with capital raising.
The purchase will be funded by the issue of capital notes.
Registry Managers is the country's largest share registry providing registry management services to most of New Zealand's leading companies and some Australian companies with local registries.
The company has been acquired from Strauss Holdings No. 45 and RM holdings.
"Registry Managers complements the present services of Baycorp and will enable the company to continue to develop strategies associated with information and technology activities," Baycorp said.
Settlement will be in cash with short term funding provided by Baycorp's bankers. The offer is subject to formal documentation and conditional upon approval of shareholders.
